title: RegPulse FDA Compliance & Enforcement Radar Input

mode.title: Execution Mode
mode.description: Choose 'all' (40-rule listing audit + FDA Warning Letters + openFDA Recalls), 'audit_listings', 'warning_letters', or 'recalls'.

vertical.title: Product Vertical
vertical.description: Target product regulatory vertical (cosmetics, supplements, devices, pets, or general).

listings.title: Listings to Audit (Array of {sku, vertical, title, bullets, ingredients})
listings.description: Up to 200 product listings to screen against all 40 federal 21 CFR, MoCRA, DSHEA, CVM, and EPA FIFRA rules.

default.title: FDA Approved Anti-Acne Retinol Serum - Treats Eczema & Kills 99.9% Bacteria
default.bullets: Clinically proven to repair sun damage and permanently eliminate wrinkles.

warningLetterQuery.title: FDA Warning Letter Filter Keyword (Optional)
warningLetterQuery.description: Optional keyword to filter live FDA.gov Warning Letters by company, subject, ingredient, or office (leave blank for newest letters).

maxWarningLetters.title: Max FDA Warning Letters to Return
maxWarningLetters.description: Maximum number of live FDA.gov Warning Letter records to return (1 to 100).

recallQuery.title: openFDA Recall Filter Keyword (Optional)
recallQuery.description: Optional keyword to query live openFDA enforcement recalls (e.g. 'sildenafil', 'supplement', 'sunscreen', 'cream').

maxRecalls.title: Max openFDA Recalls to Return
maxRecalls.description: Maximum number of live openFDA enforcement recall records to return (1 to 100).
